More applicable to all toolchains than just Rust but oh well -- @Luke Wagner, @Till Schneidereit, and @Joel Dice from our discussions about TLS today the result of this is now at:

  • https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-libc/pull/884
  • https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wit-bindgen/pull/1752

notably not too bad and should be workable in the ecosystem, and I'm pretty confident that "bindings generators just need something that's task-local" was the only genesis of this design decision which is satisfied by the new APIs in wasi-libc
